lines: 这棵树好像可以砍断！要用居合劈来\n砍吗？
这棵树好像可以用秘传招式砍断！
It's a big boulder, but a Pokémon\nmay be able to push it aside.{be01}\nWould you like to use Strength?
好大的岩石……或许可以用秘传招式推\n动？
使出了怪力后，可以推动岩石了！
{0102:0}'s Strength made it\npossible to move boulders around!
The water is a deep blue...\nWould you like to surf on it?
Surf can't be used if you have\nsomeone with you.
好大的瀑布啊！要使用攀瀑吗？
伴随着巨大的轰响，大量的水从上方\n倾泻而下！或许可以用秘传招式攀上{be01}\n去？
It's a deep part of the sea, but a\nPokémon may be able to dive down.
It's a deep part of the sea.\nWould you like to use Dive?
{0107:0} can't be used if you have\nsomeone with you.
好像可以用秘传招式击碎！要使用碎\n岩吗？
看起来很硬的岩石……或许可以用秘传招\n式击碎？
The sea is deep here. A Pokémon may be\nable to go underwater here.
这里的水很深。要使用潜水吗？
Light is filtering down from above.\nA Pokémon may be able to surface here.
上方有亮光洒下。要使用潜水吗？
